basic_info.description: A Rare Condo Alternative with Ground-Floor Convenience!  Why settle for a condo when you can enjoy the privacy and ease of this spacious, single-level corner home with no stairs, no shared walls, and no elevator needed. Just two blocks from Glen Park Grocery Store, Bart, Coffee Shops, Restaurants, and nearby Glen Park Recreation Center, Hwy 280 on ramp. The location couldn't be more ideal. Freshly painted and filled with natural light, this large 1-bedroom, 2-bath home with large office space offers comfort and flexibility. The updated kitchen and bathrooms, hardwood floors, new carpet, dual-pane windows, and sunny atrium provide a warm, move-in-ready atmosphere.  The generous office space is currently staged as a second bedroom, offering adaptable living arrangements, while the extended garage is staged as a home office adds even more usability.  Enjoy low-maintenance, ground-floor living with no lawn to care for, making it perfect for a lock-and-leave lifestyle or someone seeking ease, accessibility, and comfort without compromising location or space.
